item.title: Rallying Cry – September 25, 2026
item.description: A groundbreaking brain tumor test cuts diagnosis time from weeks to hours, Assam’s AI platform for cervical cancer screening gets a boost from local health workers, Edmonton students get a meal lift with a new program, and Wallace and Gromit’s original puppets are up for auction!
